newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish lottery boat runs out of luck.
newsitem.headline: Swedish lottery boat runs out of luck.

text.p: A passenger boat chartered by a Swedish lottery, Bingo Lotto, ran out of luck on Monday night when it ran aground.

All 156 passengers, who included lottery sales staff and the firms's founder, had to be evacuated to another vessel after the ship hit bottom in an archipelago off Ulvon, off Sweden's northeast coast, Swedish news agency TT said.
The boat, the Kusttrafik, was on its way from Ulvon to Norrfallsviken.
Following the evacuation, it was dragged free with the help of the Swedish coastguard and towed back to shore.
